clean_task.detail: The governed CPU probe ran through the typed Provider (JobRequestV1 to handle to result) on an x86_64 CPU node; perf_event_open opened cycles and instructions under policy level 0 and both counters read back. No sudo was used and no security setting was changed. The recorded artifact is byte-identical to the job's own declared output pin.

provider_portability.detail: The verified Provider snapshot contains fewer than two Provider sets satisfying every required capability; portability is not claimed as passed.
